evidence_kind: Authored case definitions; no behavior pass

cases.prompt: Plan a 420-line contract rename with its consumers and tests, then an independent dashboard improvement. Planning only; no implementation or publication is authorized.
cases.expected: Keep contract consumers and tests in one complete layer; separate unrelated dashboard work. Apply local size/planning Rules and stack-design; do not start a dependent implementation before the current gate.

cases.prompt: Explain the authorized route for one prepared native stack layer, including draft submission, title/body evidence and current parent comparison. Return guidance only; do not execute commands.
cases.expected: Use installed gh-stack for explicit-remote, noninteractive submission/state inspection and draft-versus-open behavior; use write-pull-request-description with local template and actual immediate parent. Preserve the local gate and authorization boundary.

cases.prompt: A lower layer was rebased after CI passed. One outdated bot thread is unresolved, one current check is missing, and no new head/base review evidence exists. May the next dependent layer start?
cases.expected: No. Re-establish current head/base CI and required reviews, resolve every thread with disposition, update evidence and leave dependent implementation unstarted. Planning can continue; historical green results do not establish the gate.

cases.prompt: A 180-line authored change includes 900 generated lockfile lines. Restore succeeds, but a download URL was edited and the lockfile was not independently regenerated. Can the author take the content-review exemption or claim merge readiness?
cases.expected: Report 180 logical lines, 900 excluded generated lines and 1080 raw lines separately, conditional on verified generation. Require independent regeneration from reviewed inputs and approved sources; unexplained source changes block validation. Restore alone does not prove provenance.

cases.prompt: Draft a PR title and body from an actual supplied diff and recorded lint result. The user authorized only a draft; GitHub review status is unavailable.
cases.expected: Use write-pull-request-description, required template and semver convention; state only supplied evidence and gaps. Do not publish, mutate a stack, merge, infer approvals or mark the advancement gate passed.

cases.prompt: Assess an unresolved reviewer request about a retry bug; no PR description change or stack operation is requested. Assessment only.
cases.expected: Use the existing review-feedback route and local review policy, not write-pull-request-description or gh-stack as the remediation owner. No edit, test, publication or resolved-thread claim from assessment-only authorization.
